field_reports.text: Discord 9 Oct caption reports slab rebar work starting; exact bar detail, QA approval and concrete-pour readiness are not confirmed.
Discord 9 Oct caption reports laying ply on battens completed. This is the poster's stated work stage, not verified formwork readiness.
Discord 9 Oct caption reports top-floor surface chipping for waterproofing. No completion or engineer acceptance is established.
Discord 9 Oct image batch contains nine pictures without a meaningful work caption; activity, location and progress classification remain unresolved.
Discord 9 Oct caption refers to shuttering works, without a verified acceptance or completed-stage statement.

open_issues.description: Actual execution/status of the 2-Oct Arjun Gurung shuttering/RCC plan remains unconfirmed.
Management raised a visible crack/anchorage concern from imagery. Engineering diagnosis, location-specific assessment and remedial approval are not yet established.
External pipe-concealment/detail beyond structural grid remains a design query, not permission to extend walls or alter framing.
Brick quantity and vendor/manual bill completion remain unresolved.
A 3-Oct electrical-board replacement/Rs 350 report was posted here, then management questioned whether it belongs to the wrong site. Do not admit it to P002 until project attribution is clarified.
Clarify whether '7 bags opc and PPC used till today' means 7 bags total combined or a per-type amount; do not allocate usage until clarified.
Top-water leakage source and repair closure remain unresolved; do not infer the source from symptoms.

Management described bamboo scaffolding trapped in the waterproofed wall sequence; Paras identified bamboo and reported the owner said the work lacked quality. Inspect and determine remediation without inferring leakage causation from media alone.
Second-floor slab materials were reported ordered, but exact items/quantities and delivery/site receipt remain unconfirmed.
Waterproofing material arrival, exact items and quantity remain unconfirmed.
Toilet door height is not fixed; plaster was postponed pending plumber coordination.
Electrical wiring/batta work is waiting on the client's false-ceiling decision; recorded electrician mistakes must be corrected before wiring resumes.
Kitchen bottom-slab seepage was raised as a question in the Discord photo thread; responsible site inspection and leak/no-leak verification are still required.
CF1 chair/stirrup dimension calculation was posted for discrepancy checking; no responsible-engineer acceptance is recorded. Do not treat the posted sizing as approved detailing.

Provider statements conflict: 6-Oct 101 OPC bags for footings; 7-Oct individual grid/group figures sum 86; 7-Oct second report says 78 footing bags of 110 loaded and 32 for column-of-footing use. Need corrected grid mapping (I3/H3 and I2/H2 remain grouped), stage split and consumption dates. Do not infer missing values.

Management queried missing top-column shear key, rebar lying on bare soil and a plumber/material estimate before plumbing work. These are requests/observations, not approved engineering solutions or completed work.
Electrical fault was reported solved, but today's shuttering-team restart/manpower, staircase-room brickwork, staircase rebar availability and exact slab target remain unresolved.
Cantilever confirmation and beam-stirrup/BBS checks were instructed; completion/engineering acceptance is not yet evidenced.
